audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as continuation of Job's reply: spirit broken, burial imagery, request for pledge/guarantor, friends' blocked heart, righteous endurance, and hope descending to Sheol. Sensitive decay imagery is restrained while preserving the lament.

verses.restored: My spirit is broken; my days are extinguished; the burial place is before me.

familiar.text: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.

verses.restored: Surely mockers are with me, and my eye dwells on their provocation.

familiar.text: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?

verses.restored: Please set a pledge for me with yourself; who else will strike hands with me?

familiar.text: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?

verses.restored: For you have hidden their heart from understanding; therefore you will not exalt them.

familiar.text: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.

verses.restored: One who denounces friends for a share, even the eyes of his children will fail.

familiar.text: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

verses.restored: He has made me a proverb of peoples, and I have become one before whom they spit.

familiar.text: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.

verses.restored: My eye has grown dim from grief, and all my limbs are like a shadow.

familiar.text: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

verses.restored: The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent stirs himself against the godless.

familiar.text: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

verses.restored: Yet the righteous holds to his way, and the one clean of hands grows stronger and stronger.

familiar.text: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

verses.restored: But all of you, return and come now; I will not find a wise one among you.

familiar.text: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

verses.restored: My days have passed; my plans are broken off, the possessions of my heart.

familiar.text: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

verses.restored: They make night into day; light is near, they say, in the face of darkness.

familiar.text: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

verses.restored: If I hope for Sheol as my house, if I spread my bed in darkness,

familiar.text: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

verses.restored: if I call the pit my father, and the hidden life of the grave my mother and my sister,

familiar.text: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.

verses.restored: where then is my hope? My hope, who can see it?

familiar.text: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

verses.restored: Will it go down to the bars of Sheol? Shall we descend together into the dust?

familiar.text: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
